notes.title: TurretGirls Update v1.02 has arrived!
notes.content:
[p]Hey, Turret Squad![/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we can't thank you enough for playing [b]TurretGirls[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Based on recent feedback we’ve received from the community, the team has made the following adjustments. We hope you continue to enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/3585f35d1fa3d6bd638a97527762d2f8dfa8b40c.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]【New Features】[/b][/p][p]■ Added Suspend Save Function[/p][list][*][p]Added a button on the Supply screen to save progress and return to the Title screen.[/p][/*][*][p]If a suspend save exists, a [b]Continue[/b] button will appear in the Title Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Selecting [b]Continue[/b] will resume from the next day’s battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Suspend saves are automatically deleted under the following conditions:
　・When the game is cleared
　・When the game is over
　・When retiring via the Pause Menu
　・When selecting [b]Battle[/b] in the Title Menu instead of [b]Continue[/b] (a confirmation dialog will appear before deletion)[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Added Auto-Save for Run Progress[/p][list][*][p]Progress is now automatically saved when leaving the Supply screen.[/p][/*][*][p]This feature acts as a safeguard against unexpected interruptions such as crashes.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Added Resolution Option[/p][list][*][p]Added support for 3840x2160 resolution.
　# Please note that this does not guarantee smooth performance. Consider your PC specs when using this option.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Added Discord Link Button to Title Screen[/p][list][*][p]We look forward to welcoming more Turret Squad members to the community![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]【Adjustments】[/b][/p][p]■ Shotgun[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted so that accuracy improves while ADS is active.
　# ADS Mode is primarily a bonus feature for admiring certain “details,” but now it also affects combat performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Incendiary Rounds[/p][list][*][p]Increased attack range at all levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Upward attack range has also been increased, though the visual height remains unchanged.
　# In the previous adjustment, flame height was reduced for visibility, but aerial damage output dropped too much. This update rebalances that.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Missile Launcher[/p][list][*][p]Increased attack power at all levels.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Ballista[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted initial level performance (e.g., number of projectiles) to make it easier to use.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum level performance remains unchanged.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Flamethrower[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted visual effects to reduce processing load.
　# While a reliable weapon in certain builds, performance in the late run raised concerns, so we optimized it.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Gravity Gun[/p][list][*][p]In the previous update, both the attack range and pull range shrank each time it damaged enemies. Now only the [b]attack range[/b] will shrink, while the pull range will remain at its original size.
　# The weapon was designed to immobilize enemies by pulling them in, but its damage output had been too strong, leading to the prior adjustment.
　# However, that adjustment weakened its crowd-control effect more than intended, so this rebalancing was made.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Supply Item Draw Rates[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted so that currently equipped weapons and upgrade parts will appear more frequently than before.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]As always, thanks everyone for all the feedback![/p][p]If you like [i]TurretGirls[/i], please consider giving it a review on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]"Saving humanity, one turret (and wardrobe malfunction) at a time!"[/p]

notes.title: TurretGirls Update v1.01 is Live! Patch Notes inside!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Turret Squad![/p][p]Thank you so much for playing and enjoying [b]TurretGirls[/b]!
We've been thrilled to read all of your feedback.[/p][p]After discussion within the team, we’ve made the following adjustments.
We hope you’ll continue to enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/be74bcbc3de28ef2cfb20a973c9ed54757f162e0.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]【Update Details】[/b][/p][p]■ Added Undress Stage Option[/p][list][*][p]Added a new option that allows Girl to keep her underwear protected when her durability reaches zero.[/p][/*][*][p]When this option is enabled, the mask effect will not be displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Added Item Names to Parts List in Supply Scene[/p][list][*][p]When hovering over the parts list on the right side of the screen, the names of acquired parts will now be displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Added Generator Stats to Generator Slots in Supply Scene[/p][list][*][p]When hovering over a generator at the bottom of the screen, its performance details will now be displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Supply Item Draw Rates[/p][list][*][p]Before rerolls on Day 2, items that are difficult to purchase will appear less frequently.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Machine Gun Performance[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased attack power and knockback.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Shotgun Performance[/p][list][*][p]Increased attack power, knockback, and range.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed so that attack power and knockback decrease with distance.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Laser Cannon Performance[/p][list][*][p]Reduced knockback.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased attack power at initial level.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased attack power growth per level-up.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Diffusion Laser Performance[/p][list][*][p]Changed so that lasers curve toward the crosshair after firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased hitbox size.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased attack power at initial level.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased attack power growth per level-up.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Rocket Launcher Performance[/p][list][*][p]When hitting an enemy immediately after being fired, it now deals small damage and knockback, then pierces through without exploding.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased range.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased initial attack power and explosion radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased attack power and explosion radius growth per level-up.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Gravity Gun Performance[/p][list][*][p]Delayed the time before it begins pulling enemies in after impact.[/p][/*][*][p]Gravity orb size now decreases each time it absorbs an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted hit feeling to better match visuals against medium-sized enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Flamethrower (Standard) Performance[/p][list][*][p]Reduced attack power.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased range.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Flamethrower (Advanced) Performance[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased attack power.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced range growth per level-up.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Ballista Performance[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where range was reduced when framerate was above 90.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased range.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Adjusted Incendiary Round Performance[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where range was reduced when framerate was above 90.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased range.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that when upgrading bullet size, vertical growth is now limited.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted effect visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p]■ Other Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Enhanced death sound effects for medium and rare enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Made attacks from medium flying enemies easier to recognize.[/p][/*][*][p]Added screen shake effect when medium enemies are defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly sped up the Day display animation at wave start.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue where the character’s head would shift from the correct position.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Once again, thanks everyone for all the feedback![/p][p]If you like [i]TurretGirls[/i], please consider giving it a review on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]"Saving humanity, one turret (and wardrobe malfunction) at a time!"[/p]

notes.title: Interview with developer NANAIRO ENTERPRISE
notes.content:
[p]Hi Turret Squad![/p][p]The positive response to [i][b]TurretGirls[/b][/i] continues to pour in and blow us away! Thank you so much for the support! As promised, we are back with an interview with developer, NANAIRO ENTERPRISE![/p][p][/p][p][b]About NANAIRO ENTERPRISE[/b][/p][p]
NANAIRO ENTERPRISE is a Tokyo-based game development studio founded in July 2023 with a mission to inspire players around the world through the power of gaming. Drawing on years of industry experience, the team strives to combine creativity, ingenuity, and technical expertise to craft engaging software rooted in deep gaming culture.
[url="https://www.nanairo-enterprise.com/"]https://www.nanairo-enterprise.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/0ff942a5f85386b9300c017479fce05e68c4b0e8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What part of the game are you most proud of in [i]TurretGirls[/i]?[/h3][p]At NANAIRO ENTERPRISE, we specialize in creating female characters who are both cute and cool. We devoted the most time to the protagonist, Girl, making sure she would be a character players could truly love. We fine-tuned her right up until release.[/p][p]On top of that, we put a lot of thought into how to include tasteful, lighthearted “gentlemanly” accents for our audience. In fact, the final stage of the [b]Tear-Away Uniform Cut-in[/b] scene pushed forward full throttle![/p][p]Of course, gameplay was equally important to us. We challenged ourselves more than ever before to make sure it’s genuinely fun. Balancing was tough, but we feel the end result delivers moments of real exhilaration once you push through the challenge.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]What do you most want players to experience in [i]TurretGirls[/i]?[/h3][p][i]TurretGirls[/i] is a wholesome game at its core, and we’d love for players to enjoy the strategy of deciding which equipment to purchase from limited supplies, where to place Generators, and when to make those key decisions during battle. Sometimes you may even need to rush in and protect a Generator at the cost of taking damage. But don’t worry, the [b]Tear-Away Uniform[/b] will keep Girl safe, so you can dive into the action with confidence.[/p][p]Even if the the game feels tough at first, your [b]Turrets[/b] grow stronger the more you use them. We encourage players to keep challenging themselves and not give up. The satisfaction of overcoming it is worth it![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/5741ba54b3190f1aa96d993e3041327780bce1bc.png"][/img][/p][h3]Are there any unique episodes from development?[/h3][p]Since we’re an indie team, not everyone is a specialist in a single field. For example, Girl’s dialogue was actually written by someone who normally doesn’t do that kind of work.[/p][p]We were fortunate to have Ms. Emi Uema join as the voice actress, but before recording, we honestly weren’t sure if our lines were good enough. Once her performance was implemented, though, we couldn’t believe the quality. We thought, “Wow, maybe we’re geniuses after all! (laughs)” It really showed us just how incredible professional voice actors are.[/p][p]Normally, in the final stages of development, you wouldn’t add new content beyond bug fixes. But we came up with some adjustments for the [b]Tear-Away Uniform Cut-in[/b] scene that we thought would make it even more fun for players.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Comment to Players[/h3][p]Thank you so much for picking up [i]TurretGirls[/i].[/p][p]We at NANAIRO ENTERPRISE are a team of developers who have survived on the fringes of the game industry, like hardy weeds. We may be an eccentric bunch, but we’re proud to finally release a title full of our unique style, and it means a lot if you add it to your library.[/p][p]This is a ‘gentleman’s game’, a genre that has faced tough times recently. We’re truly grateful for the chance to release it, and we believe we’ve delivered it in the best form possible for where we are now.[/p][p]We still have many ideas we’d like to try, so we’d be delighted if you continue to support us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/47ed7529c00ce686411716b26a2dfc184f42fafc.png"][/img][/p][p]If you like [i]TurretGirls[/i], please consider giving it a review on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]"Saving humanity, one turret (and wardrobe malfunction) at a time!"[/p]

notes.title: A special message from voice actress, Emi Uema!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Turret Squad!

So far the reaction to [i][b]TurretGirls[/b][/i] has been fantastic! Thank you everyone so much for the support![/p][p][/p][p]Today we'd like to share a special message from the [i]TurretGirls[/i] voice actress, [b]Emi Uema[/b], who has really helped make 'Girl' come to life![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/5f370017be58e42b2b522f0802dc541d1b34b4bf.png"][/img][/p][p]We couldn't have made TurretGirls without her![/p][p]Stayed tuned to this space for a short interview with the developers from [b]NANAIRO ENTERPRISE[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]If you like TurretGirls, please consider giving it a review on Steam![/p]

notes.title: TurretGirls Deploys Today w/ Launch Trailer & Improved Alien-Splatting Action!
notes.content: [p]TurretGirls, the explosive railgun turret defense shooter, is officially available now on Steam! Humanity’s last hope is here, and it’s packing more firepower, sass, and omurice-fueled determination than ever. [/p][p][/p][h3]TurretGirls - Launch Trailer[/h3][previewyoutube="KucA7Wdmq4k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Since the release of the TurretGirls demo, major improvements have been made to the game, including smoother framerates, increased resolution options, new features, and polished gameplay systems. The end result? A faster, flashier, and more explosive alien-splatting experience worthy of the Planetary Alien Neutralization & Tactical Strike Unit (better known as P.A.N.T.S.U.).[/p][p][/p][h3]\[New Features][/h3][p]■ Added Generator Warning Feature[/p][p]・A warning marker appears on generators that may be destroyed.[/p][p]・Toggle display/hide in the options.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Reload Gauge/Remaining Ammo Display[/p][p]・Displays the remaining ammo for your equipped weapon and a progress bar during reloading.[/p][p]・Toggle display/hide in the options.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Added Screen Resolution Options[/p][p]・Added options for options.[/p][p](2560 x 1440, 1920 x 1080, 1600 x 900, 1280 x 720, 1136 x 640)[/p][p][/p][p]■ Added Frame Rate (FPS) Options[/p][p]・Added FPS selection options.[/p][p](30 FPS, 60 FPS, 90 FPS, 120 FPS) FPS, no restrictions)[/p][p][/p][p]■ Added a costume destruction cut-in option[/p][p]- Added an option to blur the costume destruction cut-in and the result screen when a girl dies.[/p][p]- Added a feature to adjust the blur resolution.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Full localization support[/p][p]- Localized some text that was previously limited to English.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Korean support[/p][p]- Added Korean language support.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Added an option reset function.[/p][p]- Added a feature to reset options to their default settings.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Achievement progress display[/p][p]- Progress values ​​are now displayed for cumulative achievements.[/p][p](Displayed in the details panel at the bottom left of the screen when selecting equipment in the loadout.)[/p][p][/p][p]■ Expanded costume destruction cut-in features[/p][p]- Previously, a fixed pose was assigned to each destroyed part, but now multiple poses can be selected.[/p][p]- Added new poses (4 poses). )[/p][p][/p][p]■ Clothing Destruction Cut-in Pose Selection[/p][p]- Jacket Damage: Selected from 2 poses[/p][p]- Shirt Damage: Selected from 2 poses[/p][p]- Skirt Damage: Selected from 3 poses (one of which is the same as the sock damage pose)[/p][p]- Sock Damage: Selected from 3 poses (one of which is the same as the skirt damage pose)[/p][p]- Total Damage (Nude): Selected from all poses[/p][p][/p][h3]\[Adjustments and Bug Fixes][/h3][p]- Optimization[/p][p]- Improved GPU crashes[/p][p]- Prevented the mouse cursor from going off-screen during battle[/p][p]- Adjusted mouse sensitivity range[/p][p]- Adjusted mouse input so that it's not affected by frame rate[/p][p]- Adjusted enemy hit sound effects[/p][p]- Adjusted some accessories to sway[/p][p]- Adjusted the visibility of some effects[/p][p]- Adjusted the visibility of rare enemies[/p][p][/p][h3]\[Things Considered but Discarded][/h3][p]- We received user feedback requesting that the turrets always face the crosshairs, but we decided not to implement this. The reason for this is that doing so would result in the turrets being fixed in their orientation, making it impossible to view the girl from various angles. (With the current specifications, you can also view the girl from the front.) The moment you fire, she turns to face the direction of the crosshairs, so we don't think it will be a major disadvantage for players.[/p][p][/p][p]Experience TurretGirls today at full power![/p][p]Performance? Boosted. Uniform functionality? Maybe not so much.[/p]

notes.title: TurretGirls Launches August 25th! Release Date Trailer Revealed
notes.content: [p]Aliens are pouring in from the far end of the galaxy through wormholes, rifts, and who-knows-what other space nonsense. And only one girl and her turret stand between them and total planetary annihilation![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/bec1a0c7db30d5d48aa5d0ae027d7e70796759d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Following the demo, the full release of [i]TurretGirls[/i] brings the heat with a full roster of alien bashing content, polished chaos, more outfits and gear for “Girl,” and more omurice-fueled carnage than ever before![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/c75fdc68cf255081eada1476644208e7ee25a6af.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check out the [b]new release date trailer[/b] below![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1cFtiBdwD0c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]TurretGirls[/i] is a fast-paced, on-rails turret defense shooter where you play as a lone civil servant from the elite P.A.N.T.S.U. unit (Planetary Alien Neutralization & Tactical Strike Unit), holding the line against endless alien hordes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/636bb8db771480c58cc272202daa46fa1136c452.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Strap into your upgradeable turret, build generators to charge a planet-saving superweapon, and adapt on the fly as enemies swarm from every direction.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/6c2f08029b741f7e26dc5dac0cd8b691de93481f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With flashy firepower, cheeky humor, and performance-based gear unlocks (including tactical uniform malfunctions!), [i]TurretGirls[/i] mixes high-octane action with cute, anime flair. [/p][p][/p][p]Deploying  on Steam, August 25, 2025![/p][p]Do your duty. Hold the line. And earn your rewards.[/p]

notes.title: Thank You for Playing the Demo!
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who played, dodged, defended, and well, got a little too damaged. Your feedback means the world to us, and we’re already tinkering behind the scenes to make TurretGirls even better.[/p][p]If you’d like to help shape the future of TurretGirls—or just want someone to talk to while the demo’s away—[url="https://discord.com/invite/8H9sAsSGDy"][b]come find us on Discord[/b][/url]. We’ll be there waiting!  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645023/8a832ffe6b6fc359114161cd30139cdb635f1ae7.png"][/img][/p]

This is [i]your[/i] chance to take control, blast some bugs, and help me earn those ketchup requisitions![/p][p]We've already had [i]sooo[/i] many of you play the demo and wishlist the game—thank you thank you thank you!!
